issues.problem: In an 8-second skim the Brightwave role, five years of the career, reads as generic: "Contributed" to a design system and "improved" performance, with no numbers, no stated scope and no clear personal ownership. Every frontend applicant in a pile of 120 claims this. Without a before/after metric and a clear "I built X", the strongest bullets give a recruiter no reason to move this CV above the others.
issues.fix: Fill in the Brightwave bullets with real figures and an active owner verb: e.g. "Cut Largest Contentful Paint from 4.1 s to 2.2 s by code-splitting and image optimisation" and "Built 25 components and the design tokens for a React design system used by 8 developers on 6 projects". Put the best metric in the Profile as well.

issues.problem: The Skills section lists only languages, frameworks and platforms. The terms a typical Frontend Developer posting screens on (Git, unit and end-to-end testing, accessibility/WCAG, responsive design, REST APIs, CI/CD, Agile) are absent, and Next.js is not mentioned. WordPress and SEO sit among the core skills and dilute the frontend focus. A recruiter scanning for those terms finds nothing and assumes the candidate lacks them.
issues.fix: Fill this line with what is genuinely used (e.g. Git, Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, WCAG accessibility, responsive design, REST APIs, CI/CD, Agile/Scrum) and repeat the strongest ones inside the Brightwave bullets. Move WordPress and SEO to the end of the list or drop them.

issues.problem: The dates are hard to read in a skim. The freelance job (2019 - 2020) and the Brightwave job (2021 - present) use years only, so a possible gap of up to a year is visible, while the internship uses MM/YYYY. The freelance job starts in 2019, the same year as the internship and graduation, so the order is unclear. The degree also has no school name, so a recruiter cannot verify it. Dutch is given as "native" instead of a CEFR level, which Belgian employers expect.
issues.fix: Use MM/YYYY consistently for every job, and add a one-line explanation if there was a real gap between 2020 and 2021. Add the school name to the degree. Write language levels on the CEFR scale (e.g. Dutch: C2 · English: C1 · French: B1).

strength.quote: Frontend developer working with React, TypeScript and CSS/Sass, at Brightwave Digital in Gent since 2021.
strength.why: The first line gives a recruiter the title, core stack, current employer and location straight away. It matches the target role and passes the 8-second skim.
